title: Machine Lab ABC
hook: Check each layer before blaming the whole machine.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D science-and-robots storybook, supervised lab displays and toy-like machines, clean educational layouts; visual identity: Machine Lab ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading a machine block diagram
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Machine Lab ABC an architecture stack: power, wiring/prototype, processor/firmware, communication, sensors, drivers, motors/gearbox, measurement—each layer solves a different engineering problem.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child builds a block diagram and learns that a machine fails when interfaces, voltage, addressing, code, or mechanics disagree.
